sources: spec/tmds-tx.md DR-0008 (Accepted; latency superseded by DR-0009)

rows.text: Pixel clock 74.25 MHz at the 720p60 target
Pixel clock 27.000 MHz (nominal) at the 480p fallback
10:1 serialization: eight data bits plus two control bits form one 10-bit TMDS character per lane per pixel clock
Synthesized domain runs on the 3.3 V library corners (3v00, 3v30, 3v60)
DVI 1.0 section 3.3 encoding function is preserved bit-for-bit across the pipeline restructuring
The four DVI control characters are emitted when data enable is low
Registered latency from data, de and ctrl to tmds is four clock cycles
DVI-mode framing: video and control periods only; data islands are outside this block's boundary
